title: Navimower 0.4.1-beta7

## Passive discovery MQTT callback hotfix

Beta6 restored config-entry startup, but field testing exposed two additional passive-discovery regressions.

- Import `mqtt_discovery_topic`, `sanitize_discovery_payload` and `structure_summary` from `discovery.py` in the MQTT bridge. Without these imports, incoming JSON MQTT messages failed during inventory collection before normal state/location processing.
- Repair malformed `services.yaml` indentation for the `mark_discovery_event` mower selector.
- Add regression contracts for discovery helper imports and Home Assistant service YAML parsing.
- Keep Passive protocol discovery opt-in and off by default.
- Keep beta4 pose-degraded recovery and beta3 raw-first telemetry behaviour unchanged.

Beta7 supersedes the withdrawn beta6 prerelease. Users who installed beta6 should update to beta7 and restart or reload Navimower.
